sample.task:
write a script about the Stars compete in the United States Football League (USFL) as a member club of the league’s North division. The team plays its home games at Ford Field in Detroit, Michigan.

Since their formation, the Stars have appeared in the playoffs once, won the division championship game once, and appeared in one USFL Championship Game. 


coldest game in league history but thankfully fixed roof
sample.chosen:
Title: Stars of the Gridiron - A USFL Story

INT. FORD FIELD - NIGHT

The STADIUM is filled with the ROAR of the CROWD. The STARS, in their iconic blue and silver uniforms, take the field. The CAMERA PANS to the opposing team, the BIRMINGHAM STALLIONS.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Stars, a proud member of the North Division in the United States Football League, are ready to compete. Their home, Ford Field in Detroit, Michigan, is a fortress.

FLASHBACK - MONTAGE

We see the Stars in various games, their triumphs and losses, their growth as a team. The NARRATOR guides us through their history.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Since their formation, the Stars have appeared in the playoffs once, a testament to their determination and skill. They've won the division championship game once, a hard-fought victory that echoed through the league.

INT. FORD FIELD - NIGHT (PRESENT DAY)

The game begins. The Stars and the Stallions clash on the field. The CROWD cheers as the Stars make a TOUCHDOWN.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Stars have appeared in one USFL Championship Game, a feat that solidified their place in football history.

EXT. FORD FIELD - NIGHT

The CAMERA zooms out, showing the STADIUM under the night sky. The temperature is dropping, but the fixed roof keeps the CROWD and players safe and warm.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
This game, played under the fixed roof of Ford Field, was the coldest in league history. But the Stars, undeterred, played with the heart and spirit that has come to define them.

INT. FORD FIELD - NIGHT

The game continues, the outcome uncertain. The Stars, the Stallions, the CROWD - all are locked in a battle of wills and skill.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Stars of the USFL, a team that has faced adversity and emerged stronger. Their story is one of determination, resilience, and the unyielding spirit of competition.

FADE OUT.

THE END

Narrator: The Michigan Stars continue to be a force to be reckoned with in the USFL, and fans can't wait to see what they'll do next.

Narrator: So bundle up and come on out to Ford Field to support the Michigan Stars as they take on the best of the USFL's North division.

(Cut to a shot of the stadium, with the Stars' logo shining brightly on the field)

Narrator: Go Stars!

(Fade to black)
